t: Flomasta PipeGrip Reducing Tee is a reliable push-fit water pipe fitting designed to reduce 22mm pipe to 15mm in a T-shaped branch. Its dual locking system and green band indicator ensure a secure, leak-free connection without tools or hot works. WRAS approved and compatible with copper or plastic pipe, it’s perfect for branching in tight spaces.
b: Suitable for Hard & Soft Water Areas
No Hot Works: Quick & Safe Installation
